scope: Startup-required native Message/ScriptOrigin and retained actual VM source data; selected private diagnostics, not complete error reporting or startup
owningLayers: SpiderMonkey embedding native Message/ScriptOrigin and catch-state snapshots

interfaces.name: Exception.CreateMessage/TryCatch.Message
interfaces.contract: Real rooted non-Value Message snapshots retain engine report text, source/position/origin fields and saved frames. CreateMessage reconstructs the actual Error creation stack or uses its documented current-stack fallback. TryCatch.Message uses the caught exception stack for the diagnostic location, separately preserving the Error creation stack for GetStackTrace. OOM/termination do not fabricate messages.
interfaces.effects: Engine ErrorReportBuilder uses NoSideEffects; no user coercion/getter/proxy traps are requested. Owned JS strings/fields replace borrowed transient report pointers.

interfaces.name: SavedFrame retained ScriptSource
interfaces.contract: Live captures and async lookup copies retain an actual ref-counted ScriptSource. SavedFrame finalization releases it. Lookup RefPtr owns source through allocations/GC. Retaining source does not retain a JSScript, executable function, global or Node realm. Existing source identity/provenance distinguishes compilations.
interfaces.limits: Reconstructed/structured-cloned and Wasm frames lacking source ownership remain unavailable; no source registry is invented from filenames.

interfaces.name: Message.GetSourceLine/GetScriptResourceName/GetLineNumber/GetStartColumn
interfaces.contract: Actual engine source is pinned/decoded through ScriptSource.substring and stable UTF16 chars. Line extraction respects LF, CRLF, CR, U+2028 and U+2029. Compiler-owned report line buffers are used directly when present. Saved frame points provide runtime line/column metadata; script origin offsets are converted to the native zero-based interface.

interfaces.name: ScriptOrigin.ResourceName/SourceMapUrl/LineOffset/ColumnOffset
interfaces.contract: Original ScriptSource filename, actual source-map URL and original compiler start line/column remain distinct from SavedFrame display/sourceURL. UTF8 filenames are decoded as UTF8. Missing retained compilation origin fails explicitly.

interfaces.name: Message.GetEndColumn and no-info constants
interfaces.contract: VM capture/report fields provide points, not end ranges. GetEndColumn returns the audited interface no-column sentinel 0; it does not claim a synthesized expression range. kNoLineNumberInfo/kNoColumnInfo/kNoScriptIdInfo are 0; the previous private -1 no-script-ID value is corrected.
interfaces.limits: End-range capture is an implementation gap. Original Node formatting may omit its underline; no full error-output parity claim.

implementationGaps: Compiler diagnostics with a report line but no retained source owner still lack exact compilation origin and fail origin access explicitly.
Full expression/end-range capture is unimplemented; no-column sentinel is used.
Message text comes from the real SpiderMonkey report; complete V8 message formatting, capture options and security/async/native frame parity are unproven.
Complete lifetime/OOM/reentrant/context/shutdown and structured-cloned/reconstructed metadata conformance remain incomplete.
Normal process/fatal/report/resource/accounting/loading backends remain incomplete; source policy still requires whole node_internals.h integration for the Buffer ownership bridge.
validationObligations: Distinct Error creation and throw sites; native-reference unhandled source locations retained separately from private API controls.
Source retention across function disappearance and real full GC; original/display/source-map names and offset conversion.
Exotic throw values without coercion; Unicode filenames/text and all JavaScript line terminators.
Existing40 private regressions plus5 Message drivers on Node/Chromium/Firefox/WebKit with exact same artifact/kernel.
Normal profile exact unresolved-symbol diff; strict source patch and actual prepared-source/input identities.
